title: GPS lost over the object on the Stockholm University ship

tellings.quote: And then we go over the object and Tomas said to me, "Dennis, we have problems with the GPS function."

plain: A Swedish treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg says his team found a strange object on the floor of the Baltic Sea, between Sweden and Finland. He told the podcast host Jesse Michels that in June 2025 he went back out on a research ship from Stockholm University. He says that when the ship passed over the object, a man on board named Tomas told him their GPS, the satellite system that fixes a ship's position, had started acting up. He tells it as a sign that something odd is down there.
